description: Rebuild Profile screen to match reference design with real Supabase data. Remove all fake profile data (John Doe, @johndoe, hardcoded stats). Load real user profile from Supabase 'users' and 'creator_profiles' tables. Implement clean reference UI with settings list items.
steps: Rewrite app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/screens/profile/ProfileScreen.kt to match the reference: Title 'Profile' at top left. Large circular profile avatar (centered). Edit pencil icon on the card. Username @username from Supabase. 'Member since' date. Stats row: Money earned | Total videos | Total views (use data from wallets.total_earnings and creator_profiles.completed_campaigns). 'Connected accounts' button (dark/black full-width rounded). Settings list items with icon + label + right arrow: Referrals (with 'Earn 10%' badge), Language (showing 'English'), Theme (showing 'System'), Notifications, FAQ, Resources, General Campaign Rules (with external link icon). Logout button at bottom.

Create a ProfileViewModel at app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/viewmodel/ProfileViewModel.kt: Load user profile from Supabase 'users' table filtered by current auth user ID. Load creator_profiles for creator-specific stats. Load wallet balance from 'wallets' table. Expose loading/loaded/error/empty states. Implement signOut functionality that calls AuthRepository.signOut() and navigates to Auth screen.

Create or update a UserRepository at app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/UserRepository.kt: Fetch user profile from Supabase postgrest (select from 'users' where id = auth user id). Fetch creator profile from 'creator_profiles'. No mock/fake data fallbacks - return null or error on failure.
Update navigation so that Logout from Profile navigates back to Auth screen and clears the back stack.
Remove all hardcoded 'John Doe', '@johndoe', fake follower counts (45600), fake engagement (4.2%), fake earnings (125000), fake social links from the ProfileScreen.
acceptance_criteria: ProfileScreen loads real user data from Supabase - no hardcoded names or stats
Profile shows proper loading state while fetching
Profile shows proper empty/error state if data unavailable
Settings list items match reference (Referrals, Language, Theme, Notifications, FAQ, Resources, General Campaign Rules)
Logout actually signs out via Supabase and redirects to Auth screen
Clean white UI matching reference design
verification: Run ./gradlew assembleDebug and confirm build passes
findings: ProfileScreen fully rewritten with real Supabase data. Created UserRepository (fetches from users, creator_profiles, wallets tables with DTOs). Created ProfileViewModel (sealed ProfileState: Loading/Loaded/Error/Empty, signOut via AuthRepository). NavGraph updated with onSignOut callback that navigates to Auth and clears back stack. All fake data removed (John Doe, @johndoe, hardcoded stats). ProfileViewModel uses no-arg constructor so viewModel() works without factory. Build cannot be verified in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) but code follows existing patterns exactly.
